rulings.question: Which turn scheduler and body adapter coordinate regeneration suppression, death, four-per-rest limb spawning/Exhaustion and half-Speed Charge?

unmodeled: Regeneration/death ordering, autonomous severed limbs and Charge movement are not typed.

notes: Regenerate 15 HP at turn start, suppressed next turn by Acid or Fire. Dies only when starting a turn at zero HP without regeneration. Loathsome Limbs 4/day: end any turn Bloodied after 15+ Slashing damage that turn severs a limb into Troll Limb, acting after troll. One Exhaustion per missing limb; regenerate limbs on next HP gain.
Move up to half Speed straight toward a visible enemy.
